version.changelog: 免费试用金用完时，提示注册 PatentMax 领 ¥50 并说明怎么接着用；去掉试用用户的余额提醒。

llm.summary: The inventor-search workflow is coherent, but API-key handling and cache filenames have concrete security weaknesses that warrant review.

dimensions.detail: Patent-number text becomes a cache filename without rejecting path separators. A local check showed ../../CN109761224A escapes the task cache and passes the response-number comparison. A successful matching API response could therefore write JSON outside the intended cache.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The bundled Python client uses the standard library. No remote code installation, startup hooks or privilege escalation were found. Publisher metadata is empty.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Fees and continuation checkpoints are disclosed. tools.md includes a confidentiality check explaining that technical queries reach the server. The FAQ diagnostic normally prints only the fixed pm_live_/pm_test_ prefix; this does not establish secret disclosure.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The client automatically reuses PatentMax environment or saved keys and attaches authentication to an unrestricted configurable endpoint. A local dummy-token check confirmed that its default redirect handler retains authentication across host changes and HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects. The trial-registration request itself sends only a source identifier, contrary to the scanner's exfiltration claim.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main workflow explicitly covers inventor searches, organization-based disambiguation, inventor-order checks and CSV creation. Broader patent commands are disclosed as shared utilities, so the scanner's capability-mismatch claims are not supported by the complete artifacts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before using a paid key, request endpoint restrictions, safe redirect handling and cache-filename validation. Use a dedicated limited-balance key, protect locally saved credentials, and submit only information you authorize PatentMax to receive. Query fees are disclosed; no intentional exfiltration was established.
